_comment: Copied to ~/.config/clawd/shortcuts.json on first daemon start. Edit that file; labels show on the device's Remote screen buttons (keep them short), text is typed+submitted into the focused herdr pane on a confirmed tap.

shortcuts.label: Wrap up
shortcuts.text: Save everything important from this session (memory, notes, pending items), update docs if needed, then commit and push. Finally, tell me exactly what I should say to you in a fresh session to continue where we left off.

shortcuts.label: Commit+push
shortcuts.text: Commit and push the current work with a descriptive message.

shortcuts.label: Continue
shortcuts.text: Continue from where you left off.

_comment_projects: Optional: pinned dirs for the '+ CLI' project picker (shown first, before recent Claude projects).
